cim: Business Insider Hires Truman Dickerson to Cover Technology and Artificial Intelligence
cim_eredeti: Business Insider Hires Truman Dickerson to Cover Technology and Artificial Intelligence
szoveg_eredeti:
Business Insider has hired Truman Dickerson as a reporter covering technology and artificial intelligence, following his tenure as a fellow at the publication.

Dickerson joins the technology reporting team after graduating from Boston University earlier in 2026, where he served as editor in chief of The Daily Free Press, the university’s independent student newspaper.

During his time in Boston, Dickerson also gained professional journalism experience working part time at the Dorchester Reporter and The Boston Globe.

His appointment marks a transition from his fellowship at Business Insider to a reporting position focused on the technology and artificial intelligence sectors.
